brief_description: Kling Create Element - Create custom character and object elements from images or videos for use in Kling video generation.
detailed_description:
## Kling Create Element

Create custom elements (characters, animals, items, costumes, scenes, effects) from reference images or videos. These elements can then be used in Kling video generation models to maintain consistent character and object appearances across generations.

### Reference Methods:
- **Image Reference**: Provide a frontal image plus 1-3 additional reference images from different angles
- **Video Reference**: Provide a single reference video (3-8 seconds, 1080P, 16:9 or 9:16). Audio videos with human voice will trigger voice customization.

### Supported Element Types:
Character, Animal, Item, Costume, Scene, Effect, and more.

parameters.name: element_name
parameters.description: Element name. Must not exceed 20 characters.

parameters.name: element_description
parameters.description: Element description. Must not exceed 100 characters.

parameters.name: reference_type
parameters.description: Reference method for defining the element's appearance. 'image_refer' uses multiple reference images; 'video_refer' uses a reference video.

parameters.name: frontal_image
parameters.description: Frontal reference image of the element. Required when reference_type is 'image_refer'. Supported formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png. Max 10MB, min 300px on each side, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.

parameters.name: refer_images
parameters.description: Additional reference images from different angles or close-ups. Required when reference_type is 'image_refer' (1-3 images). Should differ from the frontal image. Supported formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png. Max 10MB each.

parameters.name: refer_video
parameters.description: Reference video for the element. Required when reference_type is 'video_refer'. Audio videos with human voice will trigger voice customization. Only .mp4/.mov, 1080P, 3-8 seconds, 16:9 or 9:16, max 200MB.

parameters.name: element_voice_id
parameters.description: Bind an existing voice from the voice library to this element. Only supported for video-customized elements. Leave empty to skip voice binding.

parameters.name: tag_list
parameters.description: Tags for the element in Kling-native format: [{"tag_id": "o_101"}, ...]. Available tags: o_101 (Hottest), o_102 (Character), o_103 (Animal), o_104 (Item), o_105 (Costume), o_106 (Scene), o_107 (Effect), o_108 (Others).
